For My Bestie, Vaani 💙

Dear Bestie, Vaani 💙 Okay… first of all, I know I messed up. 😭 I thought I was being clever by “testing” Shomdutta and Adrija, but honestly, it was a really stupid idea. I used your name in something that I shouldn't have, and I understand why you felt disappointed and hurt. I never wanted to make you feel like I don't value you or our friendship. You trusted me, and I should have respected that trust instead of doing some random experiment. 🥲 And yes… I still remember: “You can't keep the value of the rakhi.” 😭 And: “I have copyright of my own name and nobody can use it.” 😂 Okay, Vaani. Copyright acknowledged. Your name is officially protected. No unauthorized usage from now on. 🤝😂 But seriously… I'm really sorry, Bestie. ❤️ I don't expect you to forget everything immediately or pretend that nothing happened. I just want you to know that I genuinely regret hurting you. Our friendship means a lot to me, and I don't want one stupid decision of mine to ruin it. So, from your dumb bestie: I'm sorry. 🥺💙 No experiments. No fake stories. No using your name without permission. 😂 Just your idiot bestie trying to make things right. Can we be besties again? 🥺👉👈
